title: Capitol Assembly Hall detailed reconstruction
status: Revision v02: structurally improved, procedurally authored GLB. NOT photogrammetric or visually indistinguishable from reference.
enhancements: actual recessed loggia walls behind separate outer wing columns
projecting bronze window frames and dressed stone courses
new dome with curved glazed clerestory and stone piers
hand-modeled carved Corinthian foliage and volutes
real geometric stair balustrades and planters
marble foyer inlays and broad paired 25-step stairs
upper mezzanine with doors and balustrades
many piece concentric chandeliers, wall sconces, bronze rails, banners and coffer details
limitations: Accuracy to concept sheet has been judged visually only; no pixel-perfect multi-camera overlay.
Reference is illustrated non-CAD art and does not uniquely specify hidden interiors.
Stair/door navigation requires collision bake and runtime QA in Godot 4.
Native .blend not possible in this runtime; editable GLB and deterministic Python source included.
